title: Ruang Jeda Pikiran
theme: Menggali ketenangan batin di tengah hiruk pikuk pikiran, menemukan jeda penting untuk memahami dan menerima diri sendiri.

cover.prompt: A minimalist apartment interior during the golden hour. Soft, warm sunlight gently bathes cream-colored walls in tranquil hues of golden-orange. The room is uncluttered, featuring perhaps a simple desk or a solitary houseplant, suggesting a space for quiet contemplation. The scene is visually serene, with subtle atmospheric light conveying a sense of thoughtful stillness. Environmental shot, focusing on the interplay of light and simple forms.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Seorang desainer grafis lepas yang terbebani oleh overthinking menemukan pencerahan kecil tentang ketenangan batin saat menata ulang ruang kerjanya dan menemukan arsip digital renungannya di masa lalu. Ia kemudian belajar mengelola pikirannya melalui rutinitas kecil dan penerimaan diri.
